name: self-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own session at a natural checkpoint, carrying a note over verbatim, with a soft context-size mark and a cost stats command

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Offer the compact tool and the context mark in this session. Set false in a project's settings to turn the plugin off there.

threshold.title: Mark threshold (tokens)
threshold.description: Context size at which Claude is first told to compact at the next natural checkpoint.

step.title: Repeat step (tokens)
step.description: After the first mark, Claude is reminded again only each time the context has grown by this much more.
